newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in somewhat livelier business on Thursday, with Zagrebacka Banka and hotelier Laguna recovering from recent losses.
* Seven of 17 issues that traded rose, six fell and four were flat.
* Volume rose to 8,828 shares, turnover almost four times higher at 10.4 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Laguna climbed 150 kuna to 1,350, with 142 shares sold.
* Top decliner fully-listed Varazdinska Banka B-series fell 10 percent to 200 kuna following 1/5 share split on volume of 50 shares.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka firmed 50 kuna to 2,100, with 3,875 shares sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
